scope.fixture: synthetic valid 8x8 grayscale SOF0 baseline JPEG with empty APP2 segments inserted before SOS; no clipboard, window, helper, package, or physical input
assertions: The valid JPEG with 4096 counted marker segments decodes to the expected opaque gray pixels.
The valid JPEG with 4097 counted marker segments is rejected with image_worker_capacity_exceeded.

limitations: This regression tests the marker-count boundary for one small synthetic JPEG, not every marker type, metadata combination, or broad JPEG corpus.
The result does not establish a hard memory bound, packaged behavior, product deadline, or complete T04 acceptance.
